newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian June industrial output up 3.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romanian June industrial output up 3.3 pct.

text.p: Romania's industrial output rose 3.3 percent in June after two months of decline, aided by strength of rises in the manufacturing sector, the National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Tuesday.
ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT JUNE 97 MAY 97 JUNE 96
NOTE: Figures are adjusted according to the number of working days. Data on 1997 are provisional.
The durable goods sector underwent the steepest recovery in June with output rising by 35.2 percent from May, the CNS said.
Industrial output was 13.77 trillion lei in June, with the six-month figure at 71.25 trillion lei, 3.6 percent up from the equivalent period in 1996, CNS data showed.
End-June inventories were 13.2 percent of six-month output, compared with 13 percent in the year ago period, with textiles and timber sectors registred the highest levels.
Some 21 percent of January-June output went to export, up from about 20 percent in the year ago period. Industry employed 5.5 million people at end-June, 28,100 less than in May.
